note: Built on measured sales rather than listings. Most of this stays empty until enrichment coverage grows — an empty instrument is honest, a national figure from twelve cards is not.

liquidity.name: Rayquaza VMAX (Alternate Art Secret)
liquidity.read: 6 sold against 29 listed — the shelf is far deeper than the demand under it. A price here is what sellers hope for, not what the market pays.
liquidity.simple: 29 of these are for sale and about 6 sold last month. More sales than listings means it moves quickly; far more listings than sales means you might wait.

gradedPremium.why: The graded sale figures carry no time window — median, count, min and max, and no date range. A median across 559 sales from $1,500 to $8,000 is a historical average, not a current price, and comparing it to today's raw price would measure the gap between now and an unknown past.
gradedPremium.whatWeWouldNeed: a from-date and to-date on the sold aggregates, or a 30/90-day window we can request explicitly

marketDemand.why: Enrichment covers 12 cards. A market-wide demand figure from that would be a national claim built on a sample you could count on your hands, so there is not one.
